description: Land Acquisition - Mathugobe, Kotapola D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels (Lots 1444-1450) in Mathugobe Village for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including lot numbers, names, claimants, extents, and boundaries. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
